items.title: Harta Diasporei
items.subtitle: A community-driven platform for Romanian-speaking diaspora
items.description:
Harta diasporei is my NGO's first digital product, and I'm very proud of it.

Together with Theo Costea and the whole DCB team, we have created an open-source, free-to-use map that allows Romanian communities to create a visual representation of all the places where Romanian can be spoken in their city.

The challenge of the project is to meet the needs of the many users we serve: community members organisers, and DCB admins.

items.title: Colgate-Palmolive
items.subtitle: Case Study
items.description:
During my time at Market Logic Software (MLS), I trained NLP models to extract information from market research to enhance the insight platforms of industry leaders such as Coca-Cola, Procter & Gamble, Unilever and Colgate-Palmolive.

What my team and I actually did was first prepare market research reports and data from syndicated sources and social media for human annotation. We then tagged entities relevant to the client, such as their products, and customer sentiment. Finally, we trained and evaluated the models, which were then sent to production.
